name: treasury-cash-forecast
description: A 12-month monthly direct cash-flow forecast for corporate treasury. Fill one Excel template with your past cash flows, the payments you already know and your what-ifs; get one workbook with a base case and every scenario, reconciled to the cent, with every figure traced to the row of your input. The numbers come from a tested engine, not from the language model.

interface.longDescription:
Treasury Cash Forecast builds a 12-month, month-by-month direct cash-flow forecast for one company in one currency.

You fill one Excel template (or four CSV files) with your past monthly cash flows, the payments and receipts you already know, and your what-if scenarios. The plugin checks the file, runs a base case and every scenario, and returns one Excel workbook: a summary, a cash-flow statement per scenario, a plain-language page on how the forecast is built, and a sheet that traces every forecast figure to the row of your input.

The arithmetic is done by a forecasting engine that ships inside the plugin, using statistical models such as ETS and SARIMA. The assistant picks the command and explains the result; it does not calculate the figures. Every month reconciles from opening to closing cash.

Included: an empty template and two invented example companies, a manufacturer and a hotel with seasonal cash, so you can try it without your own data.

It needs code execution with Python and two open-source libraries, statsmodels and openpyxl. It makes no other network calls, needs no account and collects no data.

Limits: monthly, 12 months ahead, one currency, one entity, no uncertainty range. It is a forecasting aid, not financial advice; a qualified person must review the result.
